messages:
isabel: Pushed runtime 3.5.1 to nightly canary ~20m ago. Quick smoke shows a small class of binding mismatches when routes fallback to legacy runtime for quant-embed models. Not widespread but reproducible.

deploybot: canary summary: https://deploys.redwood/canary/1790012345 — overall green, embeddings-fallback cohort ~1.8% mismatch.
tariq: Repro on my side: trigger fallback by saturating main runtime, then /v1/embeddings returns different shape (extra metadata header) -> downstream `bind_error`. Looks like a serialization header version mismatch (v2 vs v1).
yvonne: If it's a header/version thing we can either pin SDK or translate in the router. Prefer minimal customer impact: pin router policy to avoid fallback for stable-embeds routes and ship a translation shim in parallel.
isabel: Agreed. Proposed immediate action: apply router safelist to prefer primary runtime for model_glob "*quant-embed*" on prod cohorts, deploy shim to translate legacy payloads, and open a follow-up to harden selector heuristics.
ops-bot: Pin request queued by @isabel for cohort "stable-embeds-prod" at 1790013000.
deploybot: Pin applied at 1790013000 to cohort "stable-embeds-prod" by @isabel. Pin metadata: ```
pinlist:
- router_policy: "prefer-primary-for-model:*quant-embed*"
  applied_by: "isabel"
  reason: "legacy runtime fallback yields serialization header mismatch for embeddings"
  owner: "eng-platform"
  applied_at: "1790013000"
```
tariq: Shim PR opened: https://git.redwood/router/pulls/1234 — normalizes header v1->v2 and strips deprecated meta. Added integration tests and a 10k request canary run.
yvonne: Monitoring plan: overlay 5% synthetic traffic through both paths for 30m, assert embedding length and checksum parity. Rollback triggers: fallback-mismatch >2% sustained for 10m OR p99 embed latency +40% vs baseline.
isabel: Release-notes blurb draft: "Interim router safelist applied for quantized embedding models to avoid fallback-induced binding mismatches. A translation shim is being rolled to normalize legacy payloads; full selector fix to follow."
deploybot: Canary shim run complete: mismatch rate dropped to 0.15% over 30m.
yvonne: If canary holds, plan prod ramp: apply pin -> 10% traffic for 20m -> 50% -> 100% with smoke checks at each step. We should schedule an ops handoff for next night shift in case of drift.
isabel: TL;DR: router safelist pin applied, shim merged to canary, monitoring + rollback criteria set, prod ramp plan ready. Will file a follow-up ticket to update selector heuristics and add a persistent compatibility note in the release notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
